intent: Phase 7, fourth: declare retention for the two unbounded tables and implement the prune. Warrant WG-ARCH-008 (A with C's seam), ruled by the operator. analytics_events and chat_messages are append-only with no expiry column, on machines belonging to people the operator has never met. Source row WO-0009. Runs only after T-0016 has captured history, and the operator merges this task because it is data safety. Acceptance: (1) the consumer, the retention window, the prune path and the split migration written into the migration headers and an ADR; (2) the prune implemented; (3) ordered after T-0016, so no history is destroyed before it is captured. Done when neither table can grow without bound, and the owner of each is named. Tier proposal R3, matching the declared facts: the prune deletes rows from databases on other people's machines, which is writes-production-data and irreversible-action; migrates-schema covers the split migration; handles-pii is declared because chat_messages carries user-authored content on installs the operator does not own, which is the warrant's own reasoning. Per the plan's section 12, the acceptance oracle is authored before implementation by a session that has not seen the implementation.
